text: Very sorry to trouble you at this hour. I've got my grandson for the night, he's 11, and he's got a temperature of 37.7. I've got both Calpol and children's ibuprofen in the cupboard but I can't make head nor tail of the labels with these glasses and I don't want to give him the wrong amount. How much of either should he have for his age? Apologies again, I know you must be busy.
